quote.translation: When I said to Kiikō, who had come with me, 'It's dangerous, shall we run?', the horse turned towards us.

quote.translation: Just then I saw two men in black clothes on the far side of the horse.

quote.translation: I heard a crow cawing nearby.

quote.translation: It went on cawing for a long time in a strangely low voice."

quote.translation: The sensory datum here is that "a crow went on cawing for a long time in a strangely low voice".

regions.text: 感覺的所異は「烏が避に低い整で長く暗き穏けてるたこことである。それが、簿通院の陰氣な坂道の追想や變に低い色調の黄色の追想や胴證の長い馬の追想や、四本の足のうち一本だけ短い異様な形態の追想や鳥のやうな黒い者物を着た芝居の黒坊の追想を喚び起したのである。

quote.translation: This called up the recollection of the gloomy slope road at Denzūin, the recollection of a yellow of strangely low tone, the recollection of a horse with a long body, the recollection of a strange form in which only one of four legs is short, and the recollection of the kurombō of the theatre, dressed in black like a crow.

regions.text: それらの追想はみな成覺のうちに旅生しょうとして成覺を追つ騙け廻はすのである。そこに黄色い馬といふやうな偶然の産物が生する。それが傳通院の坂の下を向うから跛を引きながら歩いて来る。

quote.translation: All these recollections chase the sensation around, each trying to come back to life within it, and there a contingent product such as a yellow horse arises, which comes limping towards us at the foot of the Denzūin slope.

regions.text: また違つた追想は。一緒に成覺に縋り付いたり前後しで代はる替はるに成覺に追ひ付いたりする。馬の向う側に黒い者物の男がゐるかと思ふと、今度は黄色い馬が黒い着物の男に早穫りしてしまふ。

quote.translation: Different recollections, again, cling to the sensation together, or catch up with it in turn, one after another, so that just when we think there is a man in black clothes on the far side of the horse, the yellow horse in an instant turns into the man in black.
